title: Settings
sectionGeneralLead: Language, startup, how sources refresh, and what lists show.
sectionPlaybackLead: Which player opens streams and how it behaves.
sectionPlayersLead: Where mpv and VLC live, and extra arguments to pass them.
sectionEpgLead: Programme guide sources and how the guide is shown.
sectionMetadataLead: Posters, plots and ratings from TMDB for movies and series.
sectionAppearanceLead: Theme, accent color, sizes and the home screen.
sectionRemoteLead: Control playback from a phone on the same network.
sectionBackupLead: Copy your sources, favorites and settings to a file, restore them, and manage what the app keeps on disk.
sectionShortcutsLead: Every shortcut available right now. Press ? anywhere to see them.
languageHint: Used for menus and labels. Channel names stay as your provider sends them.
coverSizeHint: Size of movie and series posters in grids.
downloadConnectionsHint: Auto downloads one file over the connections the account has spare, and goes back to one while something plays from the source. Choose 1 if the provider objects to parallel downloads.
downloadsFolderHint: New downloads are saved here. Downloads already in progress keep their folder.
downloadsFolderHintServer: Downloads are saved to this folder on the server. To move it, start the server with a different IPTV_DATA_DIR.
downloadsFolderReset: Downloads folder reset to the default
capabilitiesFailed: Couldn't check which players are available.
remoteStatusFailed: Couldn't read the remote control status.
showDashboardHint: When off, the app opens on your first source.
livePlayerHint: Used for channels playing now, including channel switching.
catchupPlayerHint: Used for past programmes opened from the TV guide.
vodPlayerHint: Used for movies and episodes on demand.
playerBuiltInHint: Plays inside the app. Works for most HLS streams.
playerEmbeddedMpvHint: mpv drawn inside the app window. Handles nearly every format.
playerExternalHint: Opens streams in a separate {{player}} window.
playerNotFound: {{player}} wasn't found. Set its path under External players.
streamFormatHint: Xtream live channels. Auto uses MPEG-TS in the built-in player, which starts faster, and HLS in mpv and VLC. Choose HLS if channels freeze or you need subtitles.
streamFormatHintServer: Xtream live channels. Auto uses MPEG-TS, which starts faster, when the browser can play it. Choose HLS if channels freeze or you need subtitles.
autoplayNextHint: Starts the next episode when one finishes.
upNextRailHint: Lists the following episodes near the end of an episode.
vodAutoFailoverHint: If a movie or episode fails to start, try the other container before giving up.
ambientModeHint: Tints the space around the video with its colors.
fullscreenChannelPanelHint: Shows the channel list at the side when you move the pointer in fullscreen.
zapBanner: Show channel info when switching channels
zapBannerHint: Shows the logo, number and what's on now and next for a few seconds after each channel change.
showCaptionsHint: Turns on subtitles when a stream has them. The built-in player can't show them in MPEG-TS streams; external players use their own setting.
doubleClickHint: A single click selects a channel; a double click plays it.
playerPathHint: Full path to the program, or empty to search PATH.
playerPathMissing: Nothing at this path any more, and no other {{player}} was found.
playerPathFallback: Nothing at this path any more. Using {{player}} at {{path}} instead.
extraArgsHint: Passed to the player before the stream URL.
epgGlobalUrlsHint: XMLTV guides used for every source, in addition to each source's own.
epgGlobalEmpty: No guide URLs added. Sources can still bring their own.
epgStatusEmpty: No guides yet. Add a URL above or add a source that includes one.
epgUnreadable: Part of this guide couldn't be read: {{skipped}} of {{seen}} programmes have a time in a format the app doesn't recognize. Check the URL or ask your provider.
epgViewModeHint: How the guide shows a channel's programmes.
tmdbEnabledHint: Sends movie and series titles to TMDB to look up posters and details.
tmdbApiKeyHint: A free v3 key from themoviedb.org, under Settings, API.
tmdbLanguageHint: Language for plots and titles from TMDB.
tmdbCacheHint: Clear it if posters or details look out of date.
tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
accentHint: Used for highlights, the selected item and play buttons.
oledBlackHint: Pure black backgrounds in the dark theme. Saves power on OLED screens and deepens contrast.
oledBlackLightHint: Applies when the dark theme is on.
densityHint: Compact fits more rows on the screen.
uiScaleHint: Scales text and controls across the app.
remoteEnabledHint: Serves a small control page with a keypad, channel search and volume.
remoteEnabledNotRunning: Remote control is on but not running.
remoteLoopbackNote: This address works only in a browser on this computer. To use a phone, see Phones on this network below.
backupExportHint: Saves your sources, favorites and settings to a JSON file.
backupIncludeSecrets: Include Xtream and Stalker passwords and keys
backupIncludeSecretsHint: When off, they are left out and must be entered again after an import.
backupIncludeSecretsWarning: Anyone with this file can sign in to your providers. Keep it private.
backupPrivacyNote: Every backup keeps playlist URLs, guide URLs and Stalker MAC addresses, which can work as logins. Keep backup files private.
backupImportHint: Restores sources from a backup made by this app or IPTVnator.
backupNoSecrets: This backup has no passwords. Xtream and Stalker sources will need them re-entered.
backupMergeHint: Adds sources from the file. Sources you already have keep their names and settings.
backupReplaceHint: Imports the backup first, then removes your current sources once one of its sources loads.
backupReplaceConfirmBody: The backup's sources are imported first. Once at least one of them loads, your current sources and their favorites and watch history are removed. If none load, nothing changes.
backupRefreshing_one: {{count, number}} source is still loading; its favorites and history appear when it finishes.
backupRefreshing_other: {{count, number}} sources are still loading; their favorites and history appear as each one finishes.
backupLegacyArray: This is an old playlist export. Export a versioned backup from IPTVnator and import that.
backupWrongFormat: This isn't a backup from this app or IPTVnator.
backupWrongVersion: This backup was made by a newer version and can't be read.
backupSkippedEntries_one: {{count}} entry isn't a source and will be skipped.
backupSkippedEntries_other: {{count}} entries aren't sources and will be skipped.
backupNoPlaylists: No sources in this file. Only its guide URLs and settings will be imported.
shortcutsNote: Shortcuts are paused while you type in a text field.
aboutServerNote: Running as a server. Folders are on the host machine.
aboutCredits: Built on ideas from IPTVnator. Movie and series data from TMDB.
errorUrlInvalid: Enter a full address, like http://example.com/guide.xml.
errorUrlScheme: Only http and https addresses work here.
errorEpgDuplicate: That URL is already in the list.
errorPathNewline: Paths must fit on one line.
errorTmdbKey: That doesn't look like a TMDB key. It should be at least 16 letters and digits.
updatesIdle: Check whether a newer version of Tsrust IPTV is available.
updatesRestart: Tsrust IPTV restarts to finish. If it stays open, close it and open it again.
updatesNotConfigured: Automatic updates are off in this version.
updatesNotConfiguredHint: New versions are published on the releases page. Download the installer there and run it to update.
stripCountryPrefix: Hide country tags in channel names
stripCountryPrefixHint: Shows "UK: BBC One", "UK | BBC One" and "[UK] BBC One" as "BBC One".
englishOnlyHint: Hides channels, movies and series whose name or category marks another language. Anything without a clear language still shows.
vodMinRatingHint: Hides titles rated below this. Titles without a rating stay visible.
recordingsFolderHint: Live recordings go to a recordings folder inside the downloads folder.
recordingsFolderHintCustom: Live recordings go to this folder.
recordingsFolderHintServer: Live recordings are saved to this folder on the server. Only the desktop app can change it.
recordingsFolderReset: Recordings go to the default folder again
playerReuseInstanceHint: Closes the previous external player before opening the next channel. VLC queues into its open window.
showExternalBarHint: Shows what plays in the external player at the bottom of the window, with a stop button.
epgOffsetHint: Moves every programme time by this many minutes. Use it when a guide runs early or late, for example 60 or -30.
errorOffsetNumber: Enter a whole number of minutes, for example 60 or -30.
errorOffsetRange: Use a shift between -720 and 720 minutes (12 hours).
epgClearHint: Deletes every downloaded programme. Guides download again on their next refresh.
epgClearConfirmBody: Every programme from every guide is deleted. Channel matches and guide addresses stay.
railsOffHint: Turn on the dashboard to use these rows.
resetHint: Puts every setting back to its default. Sources, favorites, history, downloads, guide addresses and the TMDB key stay.
resetConfirmBody: Every setting goes back to its default, including language, theme and player paths. Sources, favorites, history, downloads, guide addresses and the TMDB key stay.
streamReconnectHint: When a stream drops or stalls, retry it quietly a few times before showing an error. Movies resume where they stopped.
liveFailover: Switch live channels to another source
liveFailoverHint: When a live channel stops working, play the same channel from another source. You can undo the switch.
remoteLanEnabledHint: Lets phones on your home network use the remote. Each phone pairs once by scanning a code. Windows may ask to allow access on private networks the first time.
remoteLanConfirmBody: Other devices on your local network can reach the remote page, but only phones you pair with the code can control playback. Windows may ask to allow access on private networks; choose Allow.
remoteLanNeedsRemote: Turn on Allow remote control above to pair a phone.
remoteLanServerMode: Pairing phones is part of the desktop app. In server mode the remote control page is reachable only from the computer that runs the server.
remoteLanScanHint: Your phone must be on the same network. The code works once and expires after 5 minutes, then it is hidden again.
remoteResetBody: Every paired phone is signed out and the current code stops working. Phones must scan a new code to pair again.
remoteLanShowCodeHint: Show the code only when your phone is ready. Anyone who sees it and is on this network could pair.
remoteLoopbackNoteServer: This address works only in a browser on this computer.
refreshIntervalHint: For sources with auto refresh on. Keeps running while the app is in the tray.
refreshIntervalHintServer: For sources with auto refresh on.
expiryWarnHint: Warns on the dashboard and the source card before an Xtream or Stalker subscription runs out.
epgShortFallbackHint: For Xtream sources, show the provider's own now and next when the XMLTV guide has nothing for a channel.
recordingSectionHint: Where recordings are saved, padding for scheduled recordings, and guide reminders.
recordingPaddingHint: Programmes rarely run exactly on time. Extra minutes keep the start and the end in the file.
remindersEnabledHint: Alerts you before a programme you picked in the guide, while the app is open or in the tray.
remindersEnabledHintServer: Alerts you before a programme you picked in the guide, while the app is open.
reminderLeadHint: How long before the programme starts.
reminderActionNotifyHint: Shows a notification with a Watch now button.
reminderActionSwitchHint: Tunes to the channel and brings the app forward. You can undo it.
imageCacheHint: Posters, logos and backdrops are kept on this device, so pages you've seen fill in at once. When the cache reaches its limit, the pictures used longest ago make room.
imageCacheHintServer: Posters, logos and backdrops are kept on this server and shared by every browser that uses it, so pages you've seen fill in at once. When the cache reaches its limit, the pictures used longest ago make room.
imageCacheEmpty: Empty. Pictures are saved as you browse.
imageCacheClearBody: This removes {{size}} of saved pictures. Each one downloads again the next time it's shown.
imageCacheClearBodyServer: This removes {{size}} of saved pictures from the server. This browser downloads each one again the next time it's shown; other browsers may show their own copy for up to a week.
imageCacheUnavailable: This server has no image cache, so pictures load straight from each provider.
backupOldVersion: This backup uses an older format that can't be read. Export a new backup and import that.
backupReplacePinTitle: Enter the PIN to replace sources
backupReplacePinText: Replacing removes your current sources and their parental locks, so it needs the parental PIN.
backupParentalBody: Parental controls are locked, so the backup's parental options need the PIN. Enter it to import everything, or import the rest and keep your current parental options.
backupParentalPinTitle: Enter the PIN to import parental options
windowStartHint: How the app window opens. F11 leaves fullscreen.
sectionParentalLead: A PIN for locked channels, groups and adult content.
sectionAboutLead: Version, updates, and where your data is kept.
updatesServer: This app runs on a server, so it updates with the server.
updatesServerHint: Whoever runs the server installs new versions there, for example by updating the Docker image and restarting it. Your library stays as it is.
aboutTagline: Live TV, movies and series from your own IPTV sources.
aboutHomepageHint: Releases, documentation and source code on GitHub.
aboutIssuesHint: Open an issue on GitHub. Copy the diagnostics below into it.
aboutDiagnosticsHint: Technical details for a bug report. Nothing is sent anywhere; copy them yourself.
tmdbOffNote: Turn on TMDB above to add a key and choose a language.
playerDesktopOnlyNote: mpv and VLC are available in the desktop app.
